abstract: We study age-income gaps across 32 countries over 2004–2018 using harmonized microdata from the Luxembourg Income Study. We document a striking divergence: the ratio of disposable income of late-career workers (aged 55–64) relative to early-career workers (aged 25–34), which we name the Age Group Income Ratio (AGIR), rose by 18 percentage points in rich countries but fell by 8 percentage points in poor economies. This divergence operates primarily through the employment margin, which accounts for two-thirds of rising AGIR in rich countries and that conventional age-earnings measures miss entirely. To explain these patterns, we develop an overlapping generations model that discriminates among six competing mechanisms. In rich countries, skill congestion – late-career cohorts catching up with early-career workers in educational attainment and crowding them out of skilled labour markets – is the dominant driver of both margins. In poor countries, productivity growth dominates and skill congestion reduces rather than raises income inequality, as the young are expanding their college attainment more rapidly than the old.
abstract_zh: 我们利用卢森堡收入研究的统一微观数据，研究了2004-2018年间32个国家的年龄-收入差距。我们记录了一个显著的差异：晚期职业工人（55-64岁）相对于早期职业工人（25-34岁）的可支配收入比率，我们称之为年龄组收入比率（AGIR），在富裕国家上升了18个百分点，而在贫困经济体则下降了8个百分点。这种差异主要通过就业边际发挥作用，这解释了富裕国家AGIR上升的三分之二，而传统的年龄-收入衡量指标完全忽略了这一点。为了解释这些模式，我们构建了一个代际重叠模型，用以区分六种竞争机制。在富裕国家，技能拥挤——晚期职业群体在教育程度上追赶早期职业工人并将其挤出技能劳动力市场——是这两个边际的主要驱动因素。在贫困国家，生产率增长占主导地位，技能拥挤减少了而非增加了收入不平等，因为年轻人正在比老年人更快地扩大其大学教育程度。
title: Age-income gaps: The role of skill congestion
title_zh: 年龄-收入差距：技能拥挤的作用

abstract: This paper presents an evolutionary model of patriotism. The state interacts with a population of citizens who may differ in their levels of patriotism, reflecting how much they care about the state. Citizens’ patriotism is subject to evolutionary pressure in the long run. Under complete information, if the state’s payoff function exhibits strategic complementarity, patriotism can emerge through evolution. In the presence of incomplete information, however, patriotism fails to thrive. Despite this, if citizens can costlessly disclose their levels of patriotism to the state in a truthful but potentially imprecise manner, full information revelation can be achieved under certain monotonicity conditions—one of which can be derived from the supermodularity of the interaction between the state and citizens—thus allowing patriotism to evolve in a manner similar to the complete information case.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个关于爱国主义的演化模型。国家与一群公民互动，这些公民的爱国主义程度可能不同，反映了他们对国家的关心程度。公民的爱国主义在长期中受到演化压力的影响。在完全信息条件下，如果国家的收益函数表现出策略互补性，爱国主义可以通过演化过程产生。然而，在不完全信息条件下，爱国主义无法蓬勃发展。尽管如此，如果公民能够以真实但可能不精确的方式，无成本地向国家披露其爱国主义程度，则在某些单调性条件下——其中一种条件可源于国家与公民之间互动的超模性——可以实现完全信息揭示，从而使爱国主义得以在类似于完全信息的情形下演化。
title: The evolution of patriotism
title_zh: 爱国主义演变

abstract: In this paper, we consider two platforms that compete for the development of a new product to integrate into their ecosystems. The new product can be developed either in-house by the platforms or by an independent startup active only in the technology market. The technology of the startup can be transferred to the platforms either exclusively (startup acquisition) or non-exclusively (licensing). A platform acquires the startup’s technology either because it failed to develop the technology itself or to prevent a rival from acquiring it (a killer acquisition). The presence of the startup affects the platforms’ R&D efforts through an insurance effect, which reduces the cost of failed innovation, and a competition effect, which diminishes the returns to innovation. The magnitude of these effects depends on the merger policy decided by the competition authorities. We show that allowing acquisitions stimulates platform innovation, but at the cost of a more concentrated market structure.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了两个平台为将新产品整合进其生态系统而展开的竞争。新产品既可由平台内部开发，也可由一家仅在技术市场活跃的独立初创企业开发。初创企业的技术可以排他性（即初创企业被收购）或非排他性（即许可）方式转让给平台。平台收购初创企业技术的原因，要么是自身开发失败，要么是为了阻止竞争对手获得该技术（即“杀手级收购”）。初创企业的存在通过保险效应（降低创新失败的成本）和竞争效应（减少创新的回报）影响平台的研发投入。这些效应的强弱取决于竞争当局制定的并购政策。我们表明，允许收购会刺激平台创新，但代价是市场结构更加集中。
title: Innovation and Startup Acquisition
title_zh: 创新与初创企业收购

abstract: This paper develops a dynamic model which incorporates intra-organizational structures and bounded rationality into models of tax compliance and strategic firm behavior within a duopolistic setting where two firms with different technologies produce a homogeneous good. A linear product tax is imposed, and firms may choose partial compliance to reduce costs, at the risk of losing profits if tax evasion is detected. Each firm is functionally organized into a Manufacturing department and a Finance department. Manufacturing departments choose quantities through best-reply behavior, whereas Finance departments follow a bounded-rational gradient adjustment rule to update compliance. The interaction across departments and firms is represented by a four-dimensional piecewise smooth map. The unique Cournot–Nash equilibrium may be located either on the interior or at the boundaries of the feasible regions. According to the model predictions, the firm facing higher production costs tends to comply less; furthermore, lower tax rates promote higher compliance. As the system is analytically intractable, due to nonlinearities, boundary effects, and high dimensionality, the analysis focuses on numerical simulation. Tax rate, production inertia, compliance adjustment speed, and technological asymmetries lead to complex dynamics. The results indicate that tax evasion can compensate for cost disadvantages, affect production levels, and generate complex dynamics under the considered organizational arrangements.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个动态模型，将组织内部结构与有限理性融入税收遵从及双头垄断市场中的企业策略行为分析，其中两家技术不同的企业生产同质产品。政府征收线性产品税，企业可选择部分遵从以降低成本，但若逃税行为被查处，则面临利润损失的风险。每家企业按职能划分为制造部门和财务部门：制造部门通过最优反应行为决定产量，而财务部门则遵循有限理性的梯度调整规则来更新遵从水平。跨部门及跨企业的相互作用由四维分段光滑映射表示。唯一的古诺-纳什均衡可能位于可行区域的内部或边界上。模型预测显示，生产成本较高的企业倾向于更低程度的遵从；此外，较低的税率有助于提高遵从水平。由于系统存在非线性、边界效应及高维性，解析处理难以实现，因此分析侧重于数值模拟。税率、生产惯性、遵从调整速度及技术不对称性共同引发复杂动态。结果表明，逃税可弥补成本劣势，影响生产水平，并在所考虑的组织安排下产生复杂动态行为。
title: Tax compliance and strategic interactions in a dynamic duopoly model with product tax
title_zh: 产品税下动态双寡头模型中的税收遵从与策略互动

abstract: While a well-developed conceptual foundation for understanding underinvestment in shared goods exists, how heterogeneity in interests among a group affects expenditures relative to the socially optimal level has received little scrutiny. We show that i) the majorization partial ordering is an appropriate way to think about heterogeneous interests, and ii) reasonable technologies exist where more concentration decreases expenditure at the intensive margin, i.e., when all group members spend. However, greater concentration of interests eventually leads to greater aggregate expenditure because the least interested cease spending, leaving the burden entirely on those with most interest.
abstract_zh: 尽管关于共享品投资不足的概念基础已相当完善，但群体内利益异质性如何影响支出相对于社会最优水平的研究却鲜有涉及。我们证明：i) 主化偏序是思考利益异质性的恰当方式；ii) 在合理的技术条件下，利益集中度的提高会在集约边际上减少支出，即当所有群体成员都进行支出时。然而，利益集中度的进一步增加最终会导致总支出上升，因为兴趣最低的成员停止支出，将负担完全留给兴趣最高的成员。
title: When Free-Riding on Contributing to an Impurely Shared Good Decreases with Greater Concentration of Interests
title_zh: 当利益集中度提高时，对不纯公共品贡献的搭便车行为减少

abstract: Agricultural production is a major contributor to water pollution in China and increasingly subject to regulation. However, the effectiveness of such regulation—particularly for non-point source pollution—remains underexplored. This paper estimates the causal effects of environmental enforcement on agricultural outcomes using a spatial regression discontinuity design based on China's surface water quality monitoring network. Monitoring stations only register pollution from upstream sources, creating sharp spatial variation in regulatory pressure. After water quality performance was linked to political promotions in 2003, upstream counties experienced a significant decline in agricultural value added—about 58% lower than downstream neighbors. No such gap existed before the reform. The effect is robust to placebo tests, bandwidth changes, a difference-in-discontinuities design, and an instrumental variables strategy using hydrological station placement. To explore the channels through which regulation affects agricultural outcomes, we combine administrative data, household survey microdata, remote sensing, and emissions inventories. We find that upstream counties hired fewer agricultural workers, cultivated less land, and applied less fertilizer. Rural households in upstream counties are also more likely to migrate across counties, consistent with declining local agricultural viability. Remote sensing data confirm broad reductions in crop planting areas. N2O emission inventory data show accompanying reductions in N2O from both agricultural soils and manure. These results show that China water quality regulation can alter input use, land allocation, and emissions in agriculture. However, enforcement may also displace rural labor and reshape household decisions, highlighting important trade-offs in implementing environmental policy in developing country contexts.
abstract_zh: 农业生产是中国水污染的主要来源之一，并日益受到法规的约束。然而，此类法规的有效性——尤其是针对非点源污染的法规——仍未得到充分探讨。本文利用基于中国地表水质监测网络的空间断点回归设计，估计了环境执法对农业产出的因果效应。监测站仅记录上游来源的污染，从而在监管压力上形成了显著的空间差异。自2003年水质绩效与官员政治晋升挂钩后，上游县农业增加值显著下降，比下游邻县低约58%。而改革前并无此差距。该效应在安慰剂检验、带宽调整、断点差异设计以及利用水文站点布局作为工具变量的策略中均保持稳健。为探究法规影响农业产出的渠道，我们结合了行政数据、住户调查微观数据、遥感影像及排放清单。研究发现，上游县雇佣的农业劳动力减少，耕地面积缩减，化肥施用量下降。上游县农村家庭也更倾向于跨县迁移，这与当地农业生存能力下降相符。遥感数据证实了作物种植面积的大幅减少。N2O排放清单数据显示，农业土壤和粪便中的N2O排放相应减少。这些结果表明，中国的水质法规能够改变农业中的投入品使用、土地配置及排放。然而，执法也可能导致农村劳动力转移并重塑家庭决策，凸显了在发展中国家实施环境政策时需权衡的重要取舍。

title: Impact of Water Quality Regulation on the Agricultural Economy in China
title_zh: 水质监管对中国农业经济的影响

abstract: Institutions are crucial for allocating natural resources. Surface water allocation in the western U.S. follows the prior appropriation doctrine, which distributes water based on the date when water was first appropriated for beneficial use. During scarcity, water is allocated by seniority, with holders of more junior rights losing access first. Curtailments of water access influence the profitability of irrigated production, especially in the arid West where most croplands depend on irrigation. The Ricardian theory of rent suggests a premium for senior water rights, as the net present value of long-term returns is higher due to more secure access. We estimate this premium using a hedonic pricing model and agricultural land transactions as proxies for water-rights values. Our dataset links roughly 25,000 sales across 37 Colorado counties with geocoded information on associated water rights. Results show that surface-water access increases land values by about $6,300 per acre, or 64 % relative to similar non-irrigated parcels. Furthermore, we estimate the premium for properties that are one year more senior in water rights to be about $49 per acre. Our results also indicate that properties with access to storage and supplementary groundwater rights sell, on average, for 16% and 14% more, respectively, compared to irrigated properties with only surface water access. These findings highlight the importance of water security in shaping agricultural land markets and offer insights into how policy measures, such as expanding water markets or investing in storage reservoirs, can potentially improve allocation and reduce vulnerability of irrigated agriculture.
abstract_zh: 制度在自然资源分配中至关重要。美国西部的地表水分配遵循先占原则，即根据水首次被用于有益用途的日期来分配水资源。在缺水时期，水按资历分配，持有较新水权者首先失去使用权。水的获取限制影响着灌溉生产的盈利能力，尤其是在干旱的西部，大多数农田依赖灌溉。李嘉图地租理论表明，由于更稳定的获取权，长期收益的净现值更高，因此资深水权存在溢价。我们利用特征价格模型和农业土地交易作为水权价值的代理，来估算这一溢价。我们的数据集将科罗拉多州37个县约25,000笔销售与相关水权的地理编码信息相连接。结果显示，地表水的获取使土地价值每英亩增加约6,300美元，相对于类似的非灌溉地块高出64%。此外，我们估算，水权资历每多一年的物业溢价约为每英亩49美元。我们的结果还表明，拥有蓄水设施和补充地下水权的物业，其售价平均分别比仅拥有地表水权的灌溉物业高出16%和14%。这些发现凸显了水安全在塑造农业土地市场中的重要性，并为政策制定提供了见解，如扩大水市场或投资于蓄水水库，这些措施有望改善水资源分配并降低灌溉农业的脆弱性。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: The value of water access security in agriculture
title_zh: 农业用水安全保障的价值

abstract: This study examines the ecosystem benefits of expanding hemp cultivation by assessing its impact on crop diversity. Using scenario‐based simulations and fixed‐effect panel regressions with county‐level data in Kentucky, we find that increased hemp acreage tends to enhance crop diversity, improving water quality and bird diversity. While agricultural policies aimed at small‐scale farmers align with improving farm profitability, broader ecological benefits may remain limited unless they reach a sufficient scale. Our findings suggest that hemp‐induced crop diversification can generate measurable non‐market economic benefits through improvements in water quality and bird diversity, highlighting the need for practical and proactive policy measures that promote smallholder participation.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过评估工业大麻种植对作物多样性的影响，探讨其带来的生态系统效益。基于肯塔基州县级数据的场景模拟与固定效应面板回归分析发现，工业大麻种植面积的增加倾向于提升作物多样性，进而改善水质与鸟类多样性。尽管面向小规模农户的农业政策与提升农场盈利能力的目标相契合，但若未达到足够规模，其更广泛的生态效益可能仍十分有限。研究结果表明，工业大麻引致的作物多样化可通过水质改善与鸟类多样性提升产生可量化的非市场经济效益，这凸显了制定切实可行且积极主动的政策措施以促进小农户参与的必要性。
title: Hemp Cultivation and Crop Diversification: Implications for Ecosystem Services in Kentucky
title_zh: 大麻种植与作物多样化：对肯塔基州生态系统服务的影响

abstract: We analyse fiscal policy in resource‐rich economies using a novel Bayesian regime‐switching panel model. The identified regimes capture pro‐ or countercyclical fiscal behaviour by allowing regime‐specific shifts in the average fiscal stance, while the switches between the regimes have the interpretation of changes in fiscal policy. Applying the model to a panel of sixteen oil‐producing economies, we show that fiscal policy has alternated between a procyclical and countercyclical regime multiple times over the sample. Furthermore, we find that fiscal policy is more volatile in the procyclical regime and that the probability of being in the procyclical regime is higher for OPEC countries than for non‐OPEC countries. We also show that following either an increase or decrease in oil revenues, the growth in government expenditures is mostly increasing, suggesting an upward bias in expenditures in oil‐producing countries. These are new findings in the literature.
abstract_zh: 我们采用一种新颖的贝叶斯体制转换面板模型，分析了资源丰富经济体的财政政策。通过允许平均财政立场发生体制特定转变，识别出的体制捕捉了顺周期或逆周期的财政行为，而体制间的转换则被解释为财政政策的变化。将该模型应用于由16个石油生产经济体组成的面板数据，我们发现在样本期内，财政政策多次在顺周期与逆周期体制之间交替。此外，我们发现顺周期体制下的财政政策波动性更大，且石油输出国组织（OPEC）国家处于顺周期体制的概率高于非OPEC国家。我们还表明，无论石油收入增加还是减少，政府支出的增长大多呈上升趋势，这暗示石油生产国存在支出向上偏倚。这些是文献中的新发现。
title: Fiscal Policy Regimes in Resource‐Rich Economies
title_zh: 资源丰富经济体的财政政策体制

abstract: We adopt a dynamic mechanism design approach to study how a revenue‐maximizing seller should sell an indivisible object when a buyer with a private value can search for an outside option with continuous‐intensity choices. We find that lowering the buyer's search cost definitely reduces the seller's revenue when the buyer's search decision is binary, as in Armstrong and Zhou (2016). In contrast, with continuous search intensity, a counterintuitive effect may arise: lowering the buyer's search cost function can, under mild conditions, actually increase the seller's revenue.
abstract_zh: 我们采用动态机制设计方法，研究当具有私人价值的买方能够通过连续强度选择搜索外部选项时，追求收益最大化的卖方应如何销售不可分割商品。研究发现，当买方搜索决策为二元选择时（如Armstrong与Zhou 2016年所述），降低买方搜索成本必然减少卖方收益。然而在连续搜索强度下，可能产生反直觉效应：在温和条件下，降低买方搜索成本函数反而可能增加卖方收益。
title: Buyer's Hidden Search With Continuous Intensity: The Seller‐Optimal Mechanism and a Perverse Effect
title_zh: 连续强度下的买方隐藏搜索：卖方最优机制与一种反常效应

abstract: We study a two‐period learning model where a sequentially rational regulator builds a reputation for strict enforcement and self‐interested firms test the regulator's enforcement propensity through their misconduct. In the transparent setting, where misconduct and enforcement are observable between the firms, the regulator's reputation concern endogenously creates positive or negative enforcement externalities between the firms. When the reputation concern is strong, the enforcement externalities are negative and dominate the information externalities, encouraging misconduct. Otherwise, both externalities are positive and deter misconduct. Although a strong reputation always benefits the regulator in the opaque setting, it often backfires in a transparent setting.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个两期学习模型，其中具有序贯理性特征的监管者致力于建立严格执法的声誉，而自利的企业则通过其不当行为来试探监管者的执法倾向。在透明环境下（企业间可观察到不当行为与执法行为），监管者的声誉关切会内生地在企业间产生正向或负向的执法外部性。当声誉关切较强时，执法外部性为负向且主导信息外部性，从而助长不当行为；反之，两种外部性均为正向，能够抑制不当行为。尽管在非透明环境下，强大的声誉始终有利于监管者，但在透明环境下，这种声誉往往会产生适得其反的效果。
title: Peer Learning, Enforcement, and Reputation
title_zh: 同伴学习、执行与声誉

abstract: A core responsibility of the Federal Reserve is to ensure financial stability by acting as the lender of last resort through its Discount Window (DW). The DW, however, has not been effective because its usage is stigmatized. In this paper, we use theory and experiments to study how such stigma can be cured. We find that behavioral inertia makes it difficult to fix a stigmatized DW, but adding a new backstop facility can help mitigate stigma. These results are consistent with the Federal Reserve’s experience. (JEL E58, G01, C92)
abstract_zh: 摘要 美联储的一项核心职责是通过贴现窗口（DW）作为最后贷款人，以维护金融稳定。然而，由于使用贴现窗口存在污名化问题，其有效性受到制约。本文通过理论与实验研究，探讨如何消除此类污名。我们发现，行为惯性使得修复污名化的贴现窗口困难重重，但增设新的后备融资工具有助于缓解污名化。这些结论与美联储的实际经验相符。（JEL E58, G01, C92）
title: Can Discount Window Stigma Be Cured? An Experimental Investigation
title_zh: 贴现窗口污名能被消除吗？一项实验研究

abstract: Aspirations are a key dimension of wellbeing but remain underexplored among agrifood system workers. This study examines the employment aspirations of 528 young individuals in Peru who intended to work in the horticultural agro-industry, using two-round panel survey data and econometric methods. Between survey rounds, 414 respondents entered employment for the first time, allowing us to analyze how early labor market experiences shape aspirations related to income, occupation, and promotion. We assess how aspirations are influenced by gender, poverty status, and the presence of workplace role models. The findings show that agro-industry jobs can raise aspirations and help reduce gender- and poverty-related gaps. Supervisors—especially those who are female and age-proximate—play a significant role in shaping youth aspirations, particularly for women. The study highlights the potential of targeted employment strategies, such as thoughtful supervisor-worker matching as practical tools to promote more equitable labor outcomes and foster upward mobility among rural youth.
abstract_zh: 愿望是福祉的一个关键维度，但在农业食品系统工作者中仍未得到充分探讨。本研究利用两轮面板调查数据和计量经济学方法，考察了秘鲁528名有意从事园艺农业产业工作的年轻人的就业愿望。在调查轮次之间，414名受访者首次进入就业市场，使我们能够分析早期劳动力市场经历如何塑造与收入、职业和晋升相关的愿望。我们评估了性别、贫困状况以及工作场所榜样人物的存在如何影响这些愿望。研究发现，农业产业工作能够提升愿望，并有助于缩小性别和贫困相关的差距。主管——尤其是女性且年龄相近的主管——在塑造青年愿望方面发挥着重要作用，对女性尤为显著。本研究强调了有针对性的就业策略的潜力，如精心设计的主管与员工匹配，作为促进更公平的劳动成果和推动农村青年向上流动的实用工具。
title: Employment aspirations of young agroindustry workers in Peru – Poverty, gender and role models
title_zh: 秘鲁年轻农业产业工人的就业期望——贫困、性别与榜样角色

abstract: Since 2015, French municipalities facing high housing market pressures have been allowed to levy a surcharge on the housing tax applied to second homes. Using a synthetic difference-in-differences design, we find a substantial decline in the declared number of second homes and a significant increase in housing tax revenues in treated municipalities, but no evidence of a decrease in housing prices. Drawing on dwelling-level transition microdata, we show that most of the apparent reduction in second homes is driven by strategic reclassification for tax purposes rather than genuine changes in occupancy.
abstract_zh: 自2015年起，面对高住房市场压力的法国市镇被允许对第二套住房征收住房税附加费。采用合成双重差分设计，我们发现受处理市镇中申报的第二套住房数量显著下降，住房税收收入显著增加，但未发现房价下降的证据。基于住宅层面的转换微观数据，我们表明第二套住房表面上的减少大部分源于出于税收目的的策略性重新分类，而非实际居住状况的改变。
title: Quantity, price, and compliance effects of a second-home taxation reform in France
title_zh: 法国第二住宅税收改革的数量、价格与合规效应

abstract: Benefit overpayments are a common byproduct of benefit programs and often lead to substantial debts among individuals. Although effective repayment and debt-relief policies are a key policy concern, empirical evidence on their impact is still scarce. In this study, we investigate the impact of welfare debt relief on labor market and mental health outcomes among financially vulnerable individuals. We exploit an eligibility cutoff applied by a Dutch welfare office to identify causal effects, using an instrumented difference-in-difference and fuzzy regression discontinuity design. Using linked administrative data, our findings suggest that debt relief reduces the use of mental health medication by about 1.1 percentage points (13.9%), consistent with lower financial stress. We find no significant effects on employment, earnings, and welfare receipt for the full sample. However, employment increases among debtors with ex-ante severe debt positions. This indicates the initial presence of debt overhang problems with larger debts.
abstract_zh: 福利金超额支付是福利项目中常见的副产品，往往导致个人背负大量债务。尽管有效的还款和债务减免政策是政策关注的重点，但关于其影响的实证证据仍然稀缺。在本研究中，我们考察了福利债务减免对财务脆弱个体的劳动力市场及心理健康结果的影响。我们利用荷兰一家福利办公室适用的资格截止点来识别因果效应，采用工具变量双重差分法和模糊断点回归设计。基于关联的行政数据，我们的研究结果表明，债务减免使心理健康药物的使用减少了约1.1个百分点（13.9%），这与财务压力降低相一致。对于全样本，我们未发现对就业、收入和福利领取有显著影响。然而，在事前债务状况严重的债务人中，就业有所增加。这表明，在债务规模较大时，最初存在债务悬置问题。
title: Welfare debt relief: Impact on employment, benefit receipt, and mental health
title_zh: 福利债务减免：对就业、福利领取及心理健康的影响

abstract: I develop a unified theoretical framework with schools and residential choices to study the welfare consequences of public schools’ switching from the traditional neighborhood assignment to the deferred acceptance mechanism. I find that when families receive higher priorities at neighborhood schools, the deferred acceptance mechanism creates higher aggregate or utilitarian welfare than neighborhood assignment. Under a common school ranking assumption, I also show that the deferred acceptance creates higher aggregate welfare with neighborhood priorities than without them.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我构建了一个包含学校与居住选择的统一理论框架，用以研究公立学校从传统学区分配转向延迟接受机制所产生的福利影响。研究发现，当家庭在学区学校获得更高优先级时，延迟接受机制相较于学区分配能带来更高的总体或功利主义福利。在共同学校排名假设下，我还证明，相较于无学区优先级的情形，带有学区优先级的延迟接受机制能创造更高的总体福利。
title: School Choice and the Housing Market
title_zh: 择校与住房市场

abstract: We revisit the evolution of the relationship between mortgage debt and income, adding to the growing literature that extends beyond the 2000s housing boom. Our analysis reveals a permanent decline in the correlation between purchase mortgage amounts and borrower incomes that occurred in the 1990s and was largely complete before the 2000s housing boom. We attribute the decline in the debt–income correlation to a transition in underwriting practices, as lenders moved from human judgment to data-driven statistical models of mortgage default that better identified risky borrowers and enabled broader access to mortgage credit. Using a simple model, we show that patterns observed in the 1990s, including slow price growth and large increases in homeownership, are consistent with a substantial expansion of credit to lower-income households.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了抵押贷款债务与收入之间关系的演变，为超越2000年代房地产繁荣的日益增长的研究文献增添了新内容。我们的分析揭示，购房贷款金额与借款人收入之间的相关性在1990年代出现了永久性下降，且这一下降在2000年代房地产繁荣之前已基本完成。我们将债务-收入相关性的下降归因于承保实践的转变，即贷款机构从人工判断转向基于数据的统计模型来预测抵押贷款违约，这些模型能更准确地识别高风险借款人，并促进了更广泛的抵押贷款信贷获取。通过一个简单模型，我们展示了1990年代观察到的模式，包括价格增长缓慢和住房拥有率大幅上升，与向低收入家庭大幅扩大信贷的情况相一致。
title: JUE Insight: Technological innovation in mortgage underwriting and the growth in credit: 1985–2015
title_zh: JUE洞察：抵押贷款承销中的技术创新与信贷增长：1985–2015

abstract: This paper examines how technological advancements in mobility—specifically, the rise of e-commerce—alter the landscape of tax competition. Previous studies typically present a monotonic relationship in which regions with larger populations impose higher tax rates. However, in reality, this relationship does not always hold. We develop a model of commodity tax competition with e-commerce and show that local tax rates can have a non-monotonic relationship with regional populations. To be more precise, when online shopping is available, the relationship between tax rates and population sizes follows a U-shaped curve: the region with the moderate population has the lowest tax rate, while areas with small or large populations set higher tax rates. This U-shaped relationship arises from the dual effects of e-commerce: changing tax bases and intensifying tax competition. This result holds regardless of how widespread e-commerce becomes, illustrating how the availability of virtual mobility reshapes traditional spatial competition.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了移动性技术进步——具体而言，即电子商务的兴起——如何改变税收竞争的格局。以往研究通常呈现一种单调关系，即人口较多的地区设定较高的税率。然而，现实中这种关系并不总是成立。我们构建了一个包含电子商务的商品税收竞争模型，并表明地方税率与地区人口之间可能存在非单调关系。更确切地说，当在线购物可用时，税率与人口规模之间的关系呈U形曲线：人口适中的地区税率最低，而人口较少或较多的地区则设定较高的税率。这种U形关系源于电子商务的双重效应：改变税基和加剧税收竞争。无论电子商务普及程度如何，这一结果均成立，从而展示了虚拟移动性的可得性如何重塑传统空间竞争。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: E-commerce Reshapes Tax Competition: U-shaped Tax Rates with Respect to Populations
title_zh: 电子商务重塑税收竞争：人口规模与税率呈U型关系

abstract: This paper analyses drought severity across Mexican regions between 2000 and 2025 using satellite-based indicators of vegetation health and surface moisture. Unlike traditional station-based measures, which depend on sparse weather data and often involve reporting delays, this approach directly captures how ecosystems respond to water stress across the entire territory. By combining these signals into a regional Normalised Difference Drought Index, the study provides a consistent, high-resolution measure of drought intensity for all Mexican states, identifying both the location and severity of water stress. The methodology enables detection of drought conditions at a finer spatial scale than conventional indicators, revealing substantial intra-state variation, such as the contrasts observed within Querétaro. The results show a persistent north–south divide: northern states, characterised by arid and semi-arid climates, experience more frequent and severe droughts, while southern regions retain higher levels of vegetation and moisture. From an economic and fiscal perspective, these patterns point to greater vulnerability in the north, where water-intensive agricultural, industrial, and energy sectors are concentrated. The findings underscore the value of near-real-time, spatially detailed monitoring to support Mexico’s climate adaptation policies and to inform the development of fiscal resilience mechanisms to mitigate climate-related risks. abstract: European consumers have withstood major shocks since 2019, including the COVID-19 pandemic, the energy and food price shock following the Russian invasion of Ukraine, and a sharp rise in the overall price level amid tightening of monetary policy. This paper constructs a new high-frequency, granular dataset from aggregated, anonymised transaction-level data from Mastercard. It estimates monthly national and TL2 subnational spending for 12 European countries and 9 COICOP spending categories from 2018 to 2024. The analysis focuses on “everyday spending”, the subset of consumption categories well captured by card payments and closest to households’ lived experience of day-to-day expenditure. Everyday spending recovered after the pandemic but has been subdued since 2022, marking a sharp deceleration relative to pre-2020 trends and has been on a weaker trajectory than suggested by annual national accounts data. Granular monthly data reveal how households adjusted spending across different categories in response to sharp changes in prices and the decline in real incomes. Subnational patterns show that poorer subnational regions experienced a stronger slowdown in everyday spending, consistent with their greater exposure to essential goods such as food and energy. At monthly frequency, increases in nominal incomes are associated with noticeable improvements in real spending. abstract: This paper considers the short- and medium-term macroeconomic effects of a broad set of structural policy changes (corporate tax measures, marginal tax wedges, ALMP spending, employment protection legislation, rental market regulations, rail infrastructure investment, and basic research expenditure), building up on the baseline results presented previously in the overview of Foundations for Growth and Competitiveness (F4GC). Using recent econometric methods, it analyzes the robustness of these results and the potential heterogeneities in reforms impacts. The evidence suggests that many reforms deliver measurable short and medium run gains when assessed on the components of growth in GDP per capita.
